flow.name: Orchestration benchmark (runtime)
flow.description: Benchmark mode graph using only engine-backed features: start/end, agent (prompt + provider/model), condition true/false, loop body/after, exclusive merge, parallel fan-out without join, and ${OUT['id']} / ${variable} interpolation.

nodes.label: 1. Intake (provider+model)
nodes.prompt:
You are step intake.
1) Greet in one short sentence.
2) Call ask_user and ask: run the FULL benchmark (YES) or the short NO path (NO)?
3) End your final reply with the single token YES or NO.
This node sets agentOptions.provider and agentOptions.model so the child uses that route.

nodes.label: 3. Gather (OUT + model)
4. Loop (body/after)
nodes.iterable: (() => { try { const v = JSON.parse(String(OUT['gather'] ?? '[]')); return Array.isArray(v) && v.length > 0 ? v : ['sample-topic']; } catch { return ['sample-topic']; } })()

nodes.label: 4a. Body (${topic})
4b. After loop
3′. Decline (inherit model)
5a. Parallel A
nodes.prompt: Parallel fan-out arm A. Reply with exactly: parallel A done.

nodes.label: 5b. Parallel B
nodes.prompt: Parallel fan-out arm B. Reply with exactly: parallel B done.
